verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a legal-paperwork SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents acting on many items at once. The Partner API works one document set at a time (create, fill forms, submit, poll), and the MCP server is described as read-only, so neither counts as a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
